lia: Heads up — I'm wiring up the Console flow for creating A/B experiments. Question: what's the recommended pattern for seeding new variants and 'anchoring' a baseline so we don't get big rebalances when we tweak weights?

sam: +1 important. We saw a 10% jump in qps last month when weights recalculated.

jordan: My proposal: two-phase rollout: seed phase (fixed seed weights for X minutes) then live phase (dynamic weights). Seed prevents sudden rebalance.

maria: UX note: need a simple toggle in the wizard: 'seed for N minutes' + numeric % per variant. keep defaults small (1% / 1 request per user).

devex: telemetry caveat — our metrics are ~30s-90s delayed in the console. If seed window is too short you can’t validate success. Recommend min 5m for anything production-ish. :alarm_clock:

ryan: API sketch (for the backend contract):

```json
{
  "experiment": "exp_xyz",
  "phases": [
    {"type": "seed", "duration_s": 300, "weights": {"control": 0.98, "variant_a": 0.02}},
    {"type": "ramp", "duration_s": 3600, "strategy": "linear", "target_weights": {"control": 0.5, "variant_a": 0.5}}
  ],
  "anchors": {"control": true},
  "min_exposure_per_variant": 1000
}
```

ryan: anchors=true means the control's absolute token buckets are preserved during internal re-optimization; avoids shuffling too much.

lia: Two questions: 1) how do we enforce per-route SLA safety? 2) how to expose 'min_exposure_per_variant' in Console without overwhelming users?

jordan: For SLA routes we should default to a hard guard that caps variant weight at e.g. 5% unless explicitly overridden by an org-admin. Add a warning banner in the UI.

maria: UI pattern: show a single advanced toggle "Allow high-risk traffic allocation" that unlocks per-route overrides. Non-advanced users get sane defaults.

devex: Also add a telemetry indicator next to the variant weight slider: green/orange/red based on observed metric delta and sample size.

sam: Ops question — if a variant gets <min_exposure_per_variant in the seed window, do we auto-extend the seed window? I'd prefer auto-extend + notify rather than fail the rollout silently.

ryan: Auto-extend seems reasonable but dangerous. Instead propose: if sample < threshold, mark experiment as "underpowered" and keep routing as-is (no ramp) until manual ack. Send Slack alert.

lia: Can we combine both? auto-extend up to a limit (2x), then flip to manual hold and create alert.

ops-bot: deploy-canary: Canary experiment "exp_xyz" seeded at 2% variant_a — started by lia. :rocket:

maria: Quick nit: show exact numbers (requests/sec, unique users seen in seed) in the Console card. People want to know whether the seed actually hit.

jordan: Implementation note — the routing layer needs to support immutable seed buckets that are only rebalanced at phase boundaries. That's a change from current continuous optimizer.

ryan: Agreed. We can implement a "phase fence" where the optimizer ignores seed buckets until the seed phase expires. Requires small state change but backward compatible.

devex: Telemetry/metrics folks: can we have a separate low-latency path for experiment signals (headlines only: counts+CTR) so the console indicator can be near-real-time? If not, make min seed duration longer by default.

sam: Also consider a "soft anchor" vs "hard anchor": soft anchor biases optimizer but still allows small shifts; hard anchor locks absolute allocation. Soft anchor recommended for low-risk, hard anchor for SLA-critical.

lia: This is helpful. Action items: 1) ryan - add phase + anchors to API spec PR. 2) jordan - design optimizer fence prototype. 3) maria/devex - mockups for the seed toggle, exposure badge, and override UX. 4) ops - define alert playbook for underpowered seeds.

maria: I'll prototype mockups by EOD Friday.

ryan: I'll open API PR with sample payload and add tests for fence behavior.

jordan: I'll spike optimizer change; estimate 3 days.

sam: I'll draft the alert text + Slack flow.

lia: Thanks — let's keep the default seed 5m @ 1-2% unless route marked high-risk. :+1:

ops-bot: alert: experiment "exp_xyz" seed reached 50 unique users — currently underpowered (threshold 100). @lia @sam

lia: noted — hold until we hit threshold or manual override.

maria: :eyes: will update UI to show the hold state and provide override button with justification field.

sam: thumbs up. small follow-up: we should document the meaning of "anchors" in internal docs (what optimizer is allowed to change).

lia: Agreed. I'll add a short section in the rollout playbook once PRs land.

ryan: one more: ensure the console's CSV export includes phase boundaries and seed durations so experiments are reproducible.

lia: Great catch. Add to API PR checklist.

maria: ok that's a good plan.

sam: :thumbsup:

lia: Closing loop — we want these changes to prevent surprise shifts and give product teams clarity during early ramps. Thanks everyone.
